events.outcome: Current Vodafone CallYa Classic has no recurring basic fee, free SIM/shipping, domestic 9 euro cents per outbound standard SMS/min and 3 cents/MB. Domestic action tariff does not establish overseas keep-number action cost or a 5-euro quarterly top-up requirement.

German prepaid identity verification is mandatory; Vodafone lists eID, passport-enabled Video-Ident/Auto-ID and in-person Postident, with registration name, address and date of birth. Method/document success is not guaranteed for China-first foreign applicants.

Vodafone 2026 InfoDok 397 lists China in roaming zone 3 and standard incoming SMS abroad free in all listed zones if roaming attaches. This is a provider tariff entitlement, not evidence that a named China bank/app OTP is delivered.

Vodafone travel-eSIM ordering/Video-Ident can begin before Germany arrival, while its voucher guide advises entering top-up/starting usage upon Germany arrival. This does not prove every passport, payment method or CallYa Classic China-first activation.

A US traveler reports completing a CallYa M eSIM purchase and passport Video-Ident before EU arrival, using a Germany hotel address; autopay required European checking, and activation abroad succeeded for this individual. Different paid CallYa M tariff; not a verified CallYa Classic China or OTP outcome.

One Germany CallYa Classic subscriber reports unexplained roughly EUR 5 charges despite sparse voice/SMS use, asking about charging lag and usage logs. No reconciliation or proved systematic billing fault; do not count as number-retention failure.

Vodafone's standing official CallYa help says service is unlimited-duration, but it MAY terminate after more than 90 days without use; warning SMS plus FOUR WEEKS to object before suspension, with refundable remaining balance. The policy does not impose EUR5/90d or EUR20/year mandatory recharges.

data.acquisitionSummary: Current Vodafone help confirms CallYa is unlimited-duration but may be terminated after more than 90 days without use; Vodafone sends an SMS first and gives 4 weeks to object before blocking. Current CallYa Classic has no basic fee; SIM/eSIM activation and physical-SIM shipping are free.

keep.action: Conservative remote keep-alive model: €5 direct online top-up at least every 90 days (≈€20/year). Current specialist guidance says a user-initiated paid call, SMS or mobile-data use can also count as activity, but the cheapest China-roaming action cost is not yet verified. 90-day inactivity can trigger a warning SMS, then a 4-week objection window before block.

data.chinaActivation: Official CallYa registration supports online AutoID/eID/Video-Chat and eSIM delivery by email; registration requires name, address and date of birth. China-first success with a Chinese passport remains unverified and document-dependent.
data.kyc: Mandatory prepaid identity verification; online or Postfiliale methods are available, with accepted method depending on ID document.
data.roamingSms: Receiving abroad works; China rates 验证中.
data.holdReason: Strictest major-market window found (90 days) + Germany KYC barrier; document as reference, not recommendation.
data.tariffSummary: No-base-fee CallYa Classic; >90 days inactivity can trigger cancellation warning, with 4 weeks to object.
guideSteps: Order the free CallYa Classic SIM/eSIM and complete identity verification.
Use the conservative €5 direct online top-up path at least every 90 days; cheaper paid usage may count, but China-roaming action cost is still unverified.

data.acquisitionSummary: Current CallYa Classic remains an advertised no-basic-fee PAYG real-mobile SIM/eSIM: physical SIM and shipping free, eSIM issuance free, domestic 9c/min or standard SMS and 3c/MB. German identity verification mandatory. The provider may terminate after >90 days without use, but gives warning SMS and four weeks to object; this is NOT an obligatory EUR5 top-up every 90 days.

keep.action: CallYa is indefinite in principle; Vodafone MAY terminate after more than 90 days without USE. Warning SMS starts a FOUR-WEEK objection opportunity before the line is blocked; customer may request remaining credit. Official Classic domestic outgoing standard SMS is EUR0.09 and usage can incur fees, but neither that domestic price nor a suggested EUR5 refill proves a guaranteed quarterly retention action for a line in China. No provider-mandated EUR20/year top-up exists in the reviewed rule. Check line status and respond to any warning rather than assuming automatic renewal.

data.chinaActivation: CallYa eSIM can be ordered and emailed after provider identity verification, which offers passport Video-Ident and Auto-ID; a Germany address is requested. One July 2026 traveller reported US pre-arrival CallYa M eSIM provisioning, but this adjacent tariff report does NOT establish universal passport eligibility, every payment method, or China-first activation of CallYa Classic.
data.kyc: Required: German prepaid identity registration, including name, address, date of birth and accepted passport/ID identification via Video-Ident, Auto-ID, eID or Postident. Foreign-passport/document-method outcome is provider/identity-partner dependent; one prearrival CallYa M success is not universal.
data.payment: Vodafone lists online prepaid refill, MeinVodafone, voucher/CallNow, bank transfer and some bank-machine methods. Autopay can require eligible European bank payment per one July 2026 traveller. An exact minimum per direct top-up, foreign-card eligibility and a compulsory quarterly recharge are NOT established.
data.wifiCalling: CallYa Classic lists Wi-Fi Calling. Availability/use outside Germany and ability to preserve an inactive line through Wi-Fi Calling alone are not established.
data.roamingSms: Vodafone 2026 InfoDok 397 lists China in zone 3 and standard incoming SMS abroad free for roaming-registered CallYa service, subject to network/device attachment. No independently confirmed CallYa Classic mainland-China bank/app OTP receipt or reliability, and free incoming texts are NOT confirmed to count as billable anti-inactivity use.
data.refund: Vodafone says remaining CallYa credit may be paid back after expiry of the four-week objection window and block; no guarantee of number recovery after block.
data.holdReason: No validated fixed annual keep-number spend or guaranteed overseas qualifying-use action; foreign identity/China-first activation and named bank/app OTP remain unverified. Provider right to terminate after >90 days inactivity with SMS/four-week objection is not a hard automatic day-90 shutdown.
data.tariffSummary: CallYa Classic has EUR0 basic fee and domestic 9c SMS/min; >90d inactivity MAY trigger provider termination, with warning SMS and 4-week objection; no validated EUR20/year mandatory recharge.
guideSteps: Choose the advertised free CallYa Classic SIM/eSIM and complete identity verification; check that the intended document and payment path is accepted.

For number retention, check actual line activity/status before the 90-day provider inactivity trigger and object to a warning SMS within four weeks. Do not rely on an unverified EUR5/quarter rule or treat free inbound SMS as qualifying activity.
